name: header_order
rule: L §2.4 Header first: model, tally, on, start, end, then use lines by name, same lines by left side, notes

name: section_kind_order
rule: L §2.4 Sections in the kind order source, unit, kind, axis, index, place, input, band, def, fill, move, ask, version

name: sections_by_id
rule: L §2.4 Within a kind, sections are sorted by id (ASCII)

name: kinds_tree_order
rule: L §2.4 kind sections print in tree order: each kind followed by its subkinds depth first, siblings by id

name: versions_last_by_known
rule: L §2.4 Versions come last, sorted by known date (a window by its first day), then id

name: blank_lines
rule: L §2.4 One blank line between sections, always, one-line sections included

name: clause_order
rule: L §2.4 Inside a section, its clause lines and notes first, in the grammar's order (§2.3): a move's on, when, leg, note; an index's assumed before its notes

name: rules_sorted
rule: L §2.4 Rules sorted by label, then by the known date of their v, a rule without v first

name: version_items_sorted
rule: L §2.4 Version items: entries into kinds and indexes first, then by target id, a keyless row first, then keys in index order

name: version_items_wider_key_first
rule: L §2.4 At one key position the wider key comes first: a key left out, then *, then a range before the keys it holds (tally 2.1.3, #59)

name: version_items_ties
rule: L §2.4 Two items every key leaves tied sort by their own canonical line, compared as ASCII (GD-28)

name: beats_sorted
rule: L §2.4 A beats list is sorted by label, with ", "

name: short_form
rule: L §2.4 Short form: a def with one rule labelled base, no v, no when, no own governs, no notes prints as def x: T = expr at E

name: short_with_notes
rule: L §2.4 A one-line def followed by note lines means the long form, its one rule labelled base, and prints as it (2.1-4)

name: numbers
rule: L §2.4 Numbers print as the shortest exact decimal, a leading 0 before the point, thousands grouped by a space, or a reduced a/b when the value doesn't terminate

name: percent_units
rule: L §2.4 A value of the unit % prints with it; the shortest exact decimal before a unit

name: expr_spacing
rule: L §2.4 Expressions: one space around binary operators and after commas, none inside brackets

name: parens_redundant
rule: L §2.4 Parentheses appear only where precedence needs them

name: parens_forced
rule: L §2.4 A to u call used as an operand and a converted flows inside a comparison are always parenthesised (parse rule 4)

name: numbers_of_any_size
rule: L §2.4 Numbers of any size print as every number does: a reduced a/b whose numerator, denominator or both pass 64 bits, and a decimal past 64 bits grouped by a space (G11, B4)

name: same_sides
rule: L §2.3 sref, §2.4 A same side of every sref form prints as written, keys and fields kept: three names deep, a field after its keys, keys after a field; each the only same item of its list (the header, a version), so no order between sides is read (#88; G11, B3)

name: same_place_keys
rule: L §2.3 sref, §2.4 A same side keyed by a keyed place prints as written, its items sorted by their left sides' place keys (a place keyed by things is one key, sorted as things are) (G12's N3; beside a row of its target, #88: m0/format/held.tsv)

name: member_absent
rule: E §3.1 step 1, L §2.4 (tally 2.1.6, #74, P15): reprint reads and pins a joint model's members as run does, before it prints anything: a member with no file is refused LOAD-PIN (refcore 2.1.5 printed it, exit 0)

name: member_changed
rule: E §3.1 step 1 (tally 2.1.6, #74, P15): a member whose text no longer has the hash its use line names is refused LOAD-PIN, before reprint prints anything

name: dup_id
rule: L §2.4, §2.5 (tally 2.1.6, #91, P22): a text with a duplicated id has no canonical form, and reprint refuses it as load does, LOAD-DUP at the second by line: a source declared twice with two texts (the fuzz input b943 minimized; refcore 2.1.5 kept one block)

name: dup_kind
rule: L §2.4, §2.5 (tally 2.1.6, #91, P22): a kind declared twice under two parents, the first a parent no line declares, is refused LOAD-DUP before anything is ordered (the fuzz input e523 minimized; its second print moved the kind)

name: unknown_prefix
rule: L §2.4 (tally 2.1.6, #91, P22): an index under a prefix no use line names can't be ordered; reprint refuses it as load does, LOAD-NAME unknown id (the fuzz input c5a8 minimized; refcore 2.1.5 stopped REFCORE-NOT-YET)

name: spacing_read
rule: L §2.4 The loader accepts any spacing the grammar allows (tally 2.1.6, #81, P21): a field spaced at its . (r .n, r. m, r . k), a call at its ( and an id at its [ read, and print touching; an item named as a calendar list word (added) touches its [; a keyword before ( keeps its space (not (…))

name: spacing_call
rule: L §2.4 (tally 2.1.6, #81, P21): a member's band call spaced at its ( (b.fee (x)) and a field spaced at its . (b .ana, b. income) read as b.fee(x) and b.ana, and print touching
